name: io.github.avivgerz-hue/unslop
title: unslop — Anti-Slop Design Engine
description: Design-system audits, Design DNA extraction, and preset enforcement for coding agents.

tools.name: unslop_audit
tools.description: Audit a frontend file or directory for AI slop. Returns the Design Integrity Score, exact diagnostics, and refactoring instructions.

tools.name: unslop_extract_dna
tools.description: Extract Design DNA from a CSS file or HTTP(S) URL and compile it into a complete design preset and Agent Skill.

tools.name: unslop_apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a built-in studio preset to project agent rules and merge unslop into .mcp.json without replacing other MCP servers.
